Contract RepairService::approve(sid: Integer,rid: Integer,reject: Boolean,suggestion: String): ApprovalHistory {
	definition:
		r: Repair = Repair.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = rid),
		s: Staff = Staff.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = sid)
	precondition:
		Repair.allInstance()->includes(r) and
		Staff.allInstance()->includes(s) and
		rid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		sid.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		reject.oclIsTypeOf(Boolean) and
		suggestion.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		let ah: ApprovalHistory in
		ah.oclIsNew() and
		ApprovalHistory.allInstance()->includes(ah) and
		ah.StaffId = s.Id and
		ah.Reject = reject and
		ah.Suggestion = suggestion and
		r.History->includes(ah) and
		if reject = true 
		then r.Process = 5 
		else true 
		endif  and
		if reject = false and
		r.Process = 0 and
		s.Role = 1 
		then r.Process = 1 
		else true 
		endif  and
		if reject = false and
		r.Process = 1 and
		s.Role = 2 
		then r.Process = 2 
		else true 
		endif  and
		if reject = false and
		r.Process = 2 and
		s.Role = 3 
		then r.Process = 3 
		else true 
		endif  and
		Repair.allInstance()->includes(r) and
		result = ah
}
